cohort: Pregnant women from three national datasets: Eunice Kennedy Shriver National Institute of Child Health and Human Development (NICHD) Maternal-Fetal Medicine Units Network Cesarean Registry (CR), NICHD Consortium on Safe Labor Registry (CSL), and a cohort of deliveries at Universal Health Services hospitals (UHS)
finding: Although anaemia was more prevalent among Black patients, the race-transfusion relationship differed between databases, indicating other unexplored factors are involved.
